program:
PARAMS = {
    "Icore":  (0.5e-6, 0.3e-6, 0.7e-6),    # per-branch core current [A]
    "Vptat":  (0.45, 0.30, 0.60),          # PTAT drop across R2 at 27C [V]
    "ratio":  (0.78, 0.65, 0.90),          # output divider ratio
    "Rdiv":   (6e6, 3e6, 12e6),            # total divider resistance
    "gmid_n": (22.0, 16.0, 26.0),
    "Ln":     (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (13.5, 10.0, 16.0),
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "Cf":     (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 4e-12),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    K = 8
    MOUT = 2
    Ic = p["Icore"]
    Iout = MOUT * Ic

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], Ic, vds=0.55)
    dvgs = math.log(K) / m1.gm_id
    R1 = dvgs / Ic

    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ic, vds=0.6)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ic, vds=0.6)

    veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log(Iout / 10e-6)
    vbg = veb + p["Vptat"]
    Idiv = vbg / p["Rdiv"]
    Iq = max(Iout - Idiv, 0.2 * Iout)
    R2 = p["Vptat"] / Iq
    Rb = p["ratio"] * p["Rdiv"]
    Ra = p["Rdiv"] - Rb

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("M4", "ng", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M1", "ng", "ng", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.M("M2", "pg", "ng", "sr", "vss", "nfet", m1.W * K, p["Ln"], m=1)
    n.R("R1", "sr", "vss", R1)
    n.M("M5", "vbg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", m3.W * MOUT, p["Lp"], m=1)
    n.R("R2", "vbg", "e", R2)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e", m=1)
    n.R("Ra", "vbg", "vref", Ra)
    n.R("Rb", "vref", "vss", Rb)
    n.C("Cf", "pg", "vdd", p["Cf"])

    # Start-up: weak always-on pull-up (~0.1 uA, 4 x L=20 stack) on su.
    # Mpd is a TRUE 2x mirror of M1 (same L), so su goes low only once the core
    # carries ~2*Icore >> pull-up current. In the zero/leakage state, Mpd conducts
    # only M1-level leakage, which keeps su high so Ms1 kicks pg->ng.
    n.M("Mpu1", "su1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("Mpu2", "su2", "vss", "su1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("Mpu3", "su3", "vss", "su2", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("Mpu4", "su", "vss", "su3", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("Mpd", "su", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2 * m1.W, p["Ln"], m=1)
    n.M("Ms1", "pg", "su", "ng", "vss", "nfet", 0.5, 1.0)

    dveb = -(1.17 + 3 * UT - veb) / 300.15
    slope_bg = dveb + p["Vptat"] / 300.15
    vref = p["ratio"] * vbg
    tc = abs(slope_bg) / vbg * 1e6 + 150.0
    Isu = 0.15e-6
    power = 1.98 * (2 * Ic + Iout + Isu + 0.05e-6) * (398.0 / 300.0)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": 0.03,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": 30.0, "startup_ok": 1}
